sourceFinding: In CotpTransportInstance.close(), the COTP DisconnectRequest is wrapped in TPKTPacket, serialized into a fixed 32-byte WriteBufferByteBased, then the entire byte array is sent via tcpTransport.write. The generated model reports a true TPKT length of 11 bytes. The other CR/DT paths in this exact source use getLengthInBytes() and allocate the correct size.
proposedCorrection: In the published close() serialization, allocate WriteBufferByteBased(new byte[tpktPacket.getLengthInBytes()]) instead of the fixed-size 32-byte array; preserve the original COTP packet fields and verify end-to-end on independent test servers.
